pages.text: Right-click a passive animal or villager with an empty Golden Lasso to capture it. Carry the filled lasso to a clear spot and right-click a block to release the mob on the adjacent face. Names and mob data are preserved.

pages.title: Capture and Release
pages.text: Hostile mobs and mobs with a target are rejected. Remove leads and passengers, stop trading with villagers, and use your own tamed animals.$(br2)If release is blocked or protected, the lasso stays filled. A filled lasso holds one mob.
